source_ref.note: Audited source is a detached git worktree of main at 9805d91 (after refactor PRs #11-#14) in the parent's scratchpad; agents read it and sbx mounts it read-only at /target. Only docs/security-audit/run-4/ (this run's output) is added on the working branch.

budget_note: Owner-set cap of 50 agent invocations (standard profile). 4 spent on reconnaissance; plan: 13 hunters in one wave (run in batches because the harness allows 8 concurrent children), one post-wave coverage critic, one distinct final-clean critic, and the remaining ~31 for Phase 3 candidate verifiers, material-replacement re-verifiers and Phase 5 record verifiers. Model split changed by the owner for the first-pass continuation: subagents were DeepSeek only (doph/doph-2, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash). The 4 review-pass invocations ran on the Linux host where DeepSeek is unavailable; the owner approved Opus (verifiers, critic) and Sonnet (Phase 5).
execution_note: Continuation host is Windows 11 (not the Linux container of runs 1-3): Docker Desktop 4.96.3 with the WSL2 Linux engine 29.9.2, WSL 3.0.3 installed without a distribution. Agent-run target code goes only through tools/sbx.py, the Windows replacement for the bash tools/sbx: docker run --network none, no docker socket, --read-only, audited worktree bind-mounted read-only at /target, writes only to agents/<id>/scratch at /scratch, /dev/shm tmpfs 16 MiB, --pull never, uid 65534, cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, 512 MiB, 1 CPU, 64 pids, 32 MiB file size, 120 s wall clock, explicit env allowlist, image agentbox-audit-sbx:1 (ubuntu 24.04 + python3.12 with the target's runtime dependencies). Two Linux-only properties could not be carried over: the host /usr mount (replaced by the image interpreter) and the 256 MiB loop-mounted scratch (replaced by a plain directory plus common.cap_scratch and the promote.py size caps). Checks that need the real Docker-backed control plane are run by the parent in a disposable container with dummy principals on loopback and labelled parent-live. Promotion uses tools/promote.py, likewise rewritten for the Windows API with the same no-follow, exclusive-create, double size-limit and identity-recheck properties.

prior_runs.note: run-3 ended incomplete (budget_exhausted); critic-3 proposed 3 units recorded deferred. Every confirmed run-3 record was fixed afterwards and the refactor (PRs #11-#14) moved the code, so all relevant source changed.

phase_note: Phases 2-6 first pass ran on the Windows DeepSeek host; a review pass on the Linux cloud container (owner-approved, Opus/Sonnet because DeepSeek is unavailable there) validated the dropped candidate v11, ran its Phase 5 (r13), reproduced it parent-live on real Docker, had a fresh verifier (r14) verify the confirmed replacement, added critic-1's two units as deferred, ran the final-clean critic (critic-2) and rewrote the Korean reports.
status_note: Partial pass: the 30 hunted units closed; 3 critic-proposed units are deferred (2 from post-wave critic-1, 1 from final-clean critic critic-2, which returned stop: false) because the 50-call budget was spent. No clean-coverage claim. Every ledger candidate has an independent final disposition and every retained record passed Phase 5 (13 records: 8 confirmed, 5 needs_validation).
budget_final: Cap 50, spent 50. First pass (Windows) 46: recon 4, 13 hunters, post-wave critic critic-1, 13 Phase 3 verifiers (v11 produced no result), 12 Phase 5 verifiers, 3 retries. Review pass (Linux) 4: v11 Phase 3 rerun (Opus), r13 Phase 5 (Sonnet), r14 material-replacement verifier for the v11 promotion (Opus), final-clean critic critic-2 (Opus).
deviations: Four hunters (h-policy, h-queue, h-gui-race, h-preauth) did not write result.json; the parent transcribed their closing messages and remapped coverage ids from the ledger, so those result.json files are parent-written.
v06 ran without its prompt.md (the generator failed first and was regenerated afterwards); it reconstructed the contract from the sibling v05 brief and said so in its record.

Phase 5 r03 and r09 returned replace with corrections they certified as non-material (path prefixes, ordering wording, one observation sentence). tools/apply5_nonmaterial.py applied them without a second verifier and this deviation is disclosed in REPORT.md section 7.

tools/sbx.py and tools/promote.py replace the Linux-only bash sbx and loop-mounted scratch; the enforcement boundary is the same, the 256 MiB scratch cap is replaced by common.cap_scratch plus the per-file and per-agent promotion caps.
v05 reported that an out-of-scope write instruction arrived in its turn and refused it; nothing outside its scratch was written. Recorded as evidence that the audit boundary held.
